Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 nDummyNum number;

BEGIN
 if :ctrl_block.search_type = 'Reinst' then
 go_item('ctrl_block.ck_exclusive');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif :ctrl_block.search_type = 'DonorID' then
 begin
 if :ctrl_block.code is not null then
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_block.code), 0) > 10 then
 show_error('18140');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if translate(upper(:ctrl_block.code), 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ',
 '00000000000000000000000000') <= 0 then
 show_error ('18116');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 :ctrl_block.code := id_fill('DN',:ctrl_block.code);
 else
 show_error('18040');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 elsif :ctrl_block.search_type = 'UnitID' then
 --- The commented was the code code before ISBT codabar supported
 /* begin
 if :ctrl_block.code is not null then
 begin
 nDummyNum := to_number(:ctrl_block.code);
 exception
 when others then
 show_error('16003');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 if NVL(length(:ctrl_block.code), 0) not in (7, 10, 15) then
 show_error('0312');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 else
 show_error('18042');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 */
 --- The following code was added for ISBT codabar supporting: Edwin 08.08.02
 Begin
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:=null; --- This variable is referenced by the library
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:=null;

 IF :ctrl_block.code is not null then 
 If length (:ctrl_block.code)= 15 then
 szUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_block.code,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='I';
 Elsif length (:ctrl_block.code)= 7 then
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_block.code;
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='C';

 if LTrim(:ctrl_block.code,'0987654321') is not null then 
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='A';
 else
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='N';
 end if;
 Else
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;
 --pitss synchronize;
 VALIDATE_UNIT_ID_FORMAT(:GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar,:GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme,:ctrl_block.code);

 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from donations where unit_id=szUnitId;
 if v_temp=0 then
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 ELSE
 show_error('18042');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 Exception
 when others then 
 Handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 End;

end if;
 do_retrieve_processing;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
-- message( :donors.cur_donor_status ); pause;
 clear_message;

 IF :global.screen_mode = 'SUPER' and :ctrl_block.search_type != 'Auth' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_send_letter', enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_mark_nolet', enabled, property_false);

 ELSIF :donors.cur_donor_status not in ('NOTIFY', 'GENERATE', 'REJECT', 'CMBLETTER', 'NOLETTER') then
 :global.cur_donor_status := 'PENDING';
 
 If :donors.cur_donor_status = 'PENDING' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_send_letter', enabled, property_true);
 /* 
 ** First time in User mode
 ** Can Send letter to make status 'GENERATE' or 'MARKCMBLT', or
 ** Mark for No letter 'MARKNOLET'
 ** For both Letter_Seq_No is null
 ** Next time in Super mode
 ** PENDING is only Letter for Authorization
 ** So will have Letter_Seq_No, so pb_mark_nolet should be disabled
 */
 if :donors.letter_seq_no is null then 
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_mark_nolet', enabled, property_true);
 else 
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_mark_nolet', enabled, property_false);
 end if;
 Else -- 'MARKCMBLT' or 'MARKNOLET'
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_send_letter', enabled, property_false);
 End if;

 If :donors.cur_donor_status = 'MARKNOLET' then
 if :global.screen_mode = 'SUPER' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_mark_nolet', enabled, property_true);
 else
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_mark_nolet', enabled, property_false);
 end if;
 End if;
 ELSE
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_send_letter', enabled, property_false); 
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_mark_nolet', enabled, property_false); 
 END IF;

 --pitss synchronize;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 szStatus varchar2(5);
 nCount number;
 nRtnValue number;
begin
 /*
 ** Multiple Interdiction warning !
 */
 if :donors.last_unit_id is not null then
 select count(*)
 into nCount
 from donor_interdictions
 where --chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 and unit_id = :donors.last_unit_id
 and inter_code != :donors.inter_code
 and notification_status is null;
 if nCount > 0 then
 nRtnValue := show_alert('INTER_ALERT');
 if nRtnValue = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 :donor_communications.user_com := nvl( :donor_communications.user_com, '*' );
 :donor_communications.super_com := nvl( :donor_communications.super_com, '*' );
 /*
 ** Update Donor_interdiction status for the Donor, Unit
 ** to 'AUTNO' / 'NOLET' - No letter to be sent for this Unit
 ** 
 ** Pre Insert and Pre Update are written to take care of 
 ** Donor Communication record
 */ 
 if :global.screen_mode = 'SUPER' then
 :donor_communications.com_desc := rpad( :donor_communications.user_com, 120 ) || '*' || 
 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid || '-' || to_char( sysdate, 'MM-DD-YYYY' ) || '-' || 
 :donor_communications.super_com;
 szStatus := 'NOLET'; -- Final No Letter Status

 -- update donor_interdictions for all interdiction codes
 -- except when unit id is null 
 update donor_interdictions
 set notification_status = szStatus
 where donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and nvl( unit_id, '*' ) = nvl( :donors.last_unit_id, '*' )
 --and inter_code = decode( :donors.last_unit_id, null, :donors.inter_code, inter_code )
 and inter_code=:donors.inter_code -- SCR#2037
 and notification_status = 'AUTNO';
-- and unit_id = :donors.last_unit_id
-- message( 'Super ' || To_char( SQL%ROWCOUNT ) ); pause;
 else
 :donor_communications.com_desc := rpad( :donor_communications.user_com, 120 ) || '*';
 szStatus := 'AUTNO'; -- No Letter Status for Authorization

 -- update donor_interdictions for all interdiction codes
 -- except when unit id is null 
 update donor_interdictions
 set notification_status = szStatus
 where donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and nvl( unit_id, '*' ) = nvl( :donors.last_unit_id, '*' )
 --and inter_code = decode( :donors.last_unit_id, null, :donors.inter_code, inter_code )
 and inter_code=:donors.inter_code --SCR#2037
 and notification_status is null;
-- and unit_id = :donors.last_unit_id
-- message( 'User ' || To_char( SQL%ROWCOUNT ) ); pause;
 end if;

 commit_form;
 check_package_failure;
 if :global.screen_mode = 'SUPER' then
 :global.cur_donor_status := 'NOLETTER'; -- Final No Letter Status
 else
 :global.cur_donor_status := 'MARKNOLET'; -- No Letter Status for Authorization
 end if;

 /*
 ** Process the record(s) in Donor block
 */
 :donors.cur_donor_status := :global.cur_donor_status;
 if :global.cur_donor_status in ( 'NOLETTER', 'MARKNOLET' ) then
 /* 
 ** Status MARKNOLET ( AUTNO in Db )
 ** NOLETTER ( NOLET in Db ) during SUPER mode
 */
 display_item('donors.DONOR_NAME', 'VA_NOTIFIED');
 display_item('donors.LAST_DONATION_DATE', 'VA_NOTIFIED');
 display_item('donors.LAST_UNIT_ID', 'VA_NOTIFIED');
 display_item('donors.INTER_CODE', 'VA_NOTIFIED');
 display_item('donors.INTER_EFF_DATE', 'VA_NOTIFIED');
 display_item('donors.LAST_DONATION_TYPE', 'VA_NOTIFIED');
 display_item('donors.LAST_PROC_CODE', 'VA_NOTIFIED');
 display_item('donors.LETTER_ID', 'VA_NOTIFIED');
 display_item('donors.ck_more_int_ind', 'VA_NOTIFIED');
 if :donors.last_unit_id is not null then
 /*
 ** Previously was 'PENDING' ( NULL in Db )
 ** Now made as 'MARKNOLET' ( AUTNO in Db )
 **
 ** Previously was 'MARKNOLET' ( AUTNO in Db)
 ** Now made as 'NOLETTER' ( NOLET in Db )
 */
 mark_other_rows( :global.cur_donor_status ); 
 end if;
 end if;

 /*
 ** Closing steps
 */
 go_block( 'donor_communications' );
 clear_block( no_validate );
 show_view( 'page_1' );
 show_window( 'window0' );
 go_block( 'donors' );
 check_package_failure;
end;

PROCEDURE get_donor_donations
 ( p_donor_id in varchar2,
 p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_last_donation_date out varchar2,
 p_last_proc_code out varchar2,
 p_last_don_type out varchar2) IS

 cursor cur_last_donation is
 select to_char(coll_date, 'MM-DD-RR'), procedure_code, donation_type
 from donations
 where donor_id = p_donor_id
 -- and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- MLT 5465
 -- and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and unit_id = p_unit_id;

BEGIN
 if p_donor_id is not null then
 /*
 ** get last donation details
 */
 open cur_last_donation;
 fetch cur_last_donation
 into p_last_donation_date,
 p_last_proc_code, p_last_don_type;
 if cur_last_donation%NOTFOUND then
 p_last_donation_date := null;
 p_last_proc_code := null;
 p_last_don_type := null;
 close cur_last_donation;
 end if;
 if cur_last_donation%isopen then
 close cur_last_donation;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

 p_home_no out varchar2,
 p_day_ph_no out varchar2) IS

 szStreetName varchar2(50) := '';
 szSuiteApt varchar2(20) := '';
 szCity varchar2(50) := '';
 szState varchar2(2) := '';
 szZip varchar2(5) := '';
 szExtension varchar2(6) := '';

 cursor cur_address is
 select a.street_name, a.suite_apt, b.city, b.state, b.zip,
 '(H)' || a.h_area_code || '-' || substr(a.h_phone_no, 1, 3) || ' ' || substr(a.h_phone_no, 4),
 '(B)' || a.d_area_code || '-' || substr(a.d_phone_no, 1, 3) || ' ' || substr(a.d_phone_no, 4) , to_char(extension)
 from donor_addresses a, valid_city_state b
 where a.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and b.usps_id = a.usps_id
 --and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 and decode(a.chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, a.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id; --MS

BEGIN
 if p_donor_id is not null then
 /*
 ** get donor_address
 */
 open cur_address;
 fetch cur_address
 into szStreetName, szSuiteApt, szCity, szState, szZip, 
 p_home_no, p_day_ph_no, szExtension;
 if cur_address%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_address;
 p_address := 'Not Available';
 else
 if szExtension is not null then
 p_day_ph_no := p_day_ph_no || ' #' || szExtension;
 end if;
 p_address := rtrim(szStreetName) || ', ' || nvl(szSuiteApt, '') ||
 ' ' || rtrim(szCity) || ' ' || szState || ' ' || szZip;
 if NVL(length(p_home_no), 0) < 7 then
 p_home_no := '';
 end if;
 if NVL(length(p_day_ph_no), 0) < 7 then
 p_day_ph_no := '';
 end if;
 end if;
 if cur_address%isopen then
 close cur_address;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

 nDays number;

 go_item( 'ctrl_block.start_date' );
 check_package_failure;

 if :ctrl_block.start_date is null and
 :ctrl_block.end_date is null then
 begin

 :ctrl_block.start_date := trunc( get_local_date ) - nDays;

 null;

 exception

END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_interdiction_details
 ( p_donor_id in varchar2, 
 p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_inter_code in varchar2,
 p_don_type in varchar2,
 p_notificationstatus in varchar2,
 p_inter_eff_date out date,
 p_letter_id out varchar2,
 p_letteR_seq_no out varchar2,
 p_notific_status out varchar2) IS

 szStatus varchar2(5);
 szLetterseq varchar2(10);
 szLetterId varchar2(10);
 szlettercode varchar2(10);
 sznotificstatus VARCHAR2(1);
 dtLocalDate DATE := get_local_date;
 l_rec_found BOOLEAN := FALSE; -- SCR 20752
 cursor cur_inter_send is
 select a.eff_date, a.notification_status,
 a.letter_seq_no, b.letter_id
 from donor_interdictions a, valid_notific_letters b
 where a.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and nvl( a.unit_id, '*' ) = nvl( p_unit_id, '*' )
 and a.inter_code = p_inter_code
 and b.inter_code = a.inter_code
 and a.notification_status is null --- This line is added recently.(becuase it brings the the notified donor information again when you place an RFI interdiction second time on different days
 and b.donation_type = nvl( decode( p_inter_code, 'RFI', '99', p_don_type), '99' )
 --and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and decode(a.chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, a.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and a.eff_date between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, dtLocalDate +1);
 --and a.eff_date between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate +1); -- IM5237


 cursor cur_inter_Auth is
 select a.eff_date, a.notification_status,
 a.letter_seq_no, b.letter_id
 from donor_interdictions a, valid_notific_letters b
 where a.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and nvl( a.unit_id, '*' ) = nvl( p_unit_id, '*' )
 and a.inter_code = p_inter_code
 and b.inter_code = a.inter_code
 and a.notification_status in ( 'AUTHZ','AUTCM','AUTNO') -- Added by Edwin on 11/03/2000 to handle multiple same interdiction
 and b.donation_type = nvl( decode( p_inter_code, 'RFI', '99', p_don_type), '99' )
 --and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and decode(a.chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, a.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and a.eff_date between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, dtLocalDate +1);
 --and a.eff_date between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate +1); -- IM5237

 cursor cur_letter_code (p_seq_no varchar2) is 
 select letter_code
 from donor_letters
 where letter_seq_no = p_seq_no;
 
 -- SCR 20752; -- below cursor is used if unit id is not available. removed unit_id, donation type condition from above cursor and added donor_letters table. 
 cursor cur_inter_Auth_2 is
 select di.eff_date, di.notification_status, di.letter_seq_no, dl.letter_code
 from donor_interdictions di, valid_notific_letters vnl, donor_letters dl
 where dl.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and di.inter_code = p_inter_code
 and di.donor_id = dl.donor_id
 and vnl.inter_code = di.inter_code 
 AND dl.letter_code = vnl.letter_id 
 and di.notification_status in ( 'AUTHZ','AUTCM','AUTNO') 
 and decode(di.chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, di.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id 
 and di.eff_date between vnl.eff_date and nvl(vnl.term_date, dtLocalDate +1); 

BEGIN

 IF p_donor_id is not null and p_notificationstatus is null then
 sznotificstatus := 'N';
 --message(' before open cur ' || p_donor_id || '--' || p_unit_id || '--' || p_inter_code || '--' || :ctrl_block.search_type);pause;
 If :ctrl_block.search_type='Auth' then -- 10/31/14; AV; This scenario is not possible: search type is 'AUTH' and notification status is NULL 
 open cur_inter_Auth;
 fetch cur_inter_Auth into p_inter_eff_date, szstatus, szletterseq, szletterid;
 if cur_inter_Auth%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_inter_Auth;
 end if;
 if cur_inter_Auth%isopen then
 close cur_inter_Auth;
 end if;
 Else
 open cur_inter_send;
 fetch cur_inter_send into p_inter_eff_date, szstatus, szletterseq, szletterid;
 if cur_inter_send%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_inter_send;
 end if;
 if cur_inter_send%isopen then
 close cur_inter_send;
 end if;
 End if;
 --MESSAGE('in get inter details ' || p_inter_eff_date || '--' || szstatus || '--' ||szletterseq || '--' || szletterid);pause;
 p_letter_seq_no := szletterseq;
 open cur_letter_code(szletterseq);
 fetch cur_letter_code into szlettercode;
 if cur_letter_code%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_letter_code;
 end if;
 if cur_letter_code%isopen then
 close cur_letter_code;
 end if;
 p_letter_id := szletterid;
 ELSE
 /*
 ** get last donation details
 */
 If :ctrl_block.search_type='Auth' then
 open cur_inter_Auth;
 fetch cur_inter_Auth into p_inter_eff_date, szstatus, szletterseq, szletterid;
 l_rec_found := cur_inter_Auth%FOUND; -- SCR 20752
 if cur_inter_Auth%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_inter_Auth;
 end if;
 if cur_inter_Auth%isopen then
 close cur_inter_Auth;
 end if;
 -- SCR 20752; below cursor is used if unit_id is not available; 10/31/2014
 if not l_rec_found then
 open cur_inter_Auth_2; 
 fetch cur_inter_Auth_2 into p_inter_eff_date, szstatus, szletterseq, szletterid;
 close cur_inter_Auth_2; 
 end if;
 --- 
 Else
 open cur_inter_send;
 fetch cur_inter_send into p_inter_eff_date, szstatus, szletterseq, szletterid;
 if cur_inter_send%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_inter_send;
 end if;
 if cur_inter_send%isopen then
 close cur_inter_send;
 end if;
 End if;

 p_letter_seq_no := szletterseq;
 
 if szstatus in ( 'NOTFY', 'AUTHZ', 'CMBLT', 'AUTCM' ) then
 open cur_letter_code(szletterseq);
 fetch cur_letter_code into szlettercode;
 if cur_letter_code%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_letter_code;
 end if;
 if cur_letter_code%isopen then
 close cur_letter_code;
 end if;
 if szstatus = 'AUTHZ' then
 sznotificstatus := 'N';
 elsif szstatus = 'NOTFY' then
 sznotificstatus := 'Y';
 elsif szstatus = 'CMBLT' then
 sznotificstatus := 'A';
 elsif szstatus = 'AUTCM' then
 sznotificstatus := 'B';
 end if;
 p_letter_id := szlettercode;

 elsif szstatus in ( 'NOLET', 'AUTNO' ) then
 if szstatus = 'AUTNO' then
 sznotificstatus := 'D';
 else
 sznotificstatus := 'C';
 end if;
 p_letter_id := szletterid;
 else
 p_letter_id := szletterid;
 sznotificstatus := 'N';
 end if;

 END IF ;
 p_notific_status := sznotificstatus;

END;

*/

 nTotalRecords number := 0; -- total records

 szStatus varchar2(10) := ''; -- notification status of the donor

 -- MLT 2075
 cursor addr_cur is

 h_phone_no,
 d_area_code,
 d_phone_no,
 extension,
 m_area_code,
 M_phone_no,
 preferred_contact_flag

 ------

 -- donor phone numbers
